resources.string: Allow camera access, or go back to use the six-digit code.
Pairing authorization expired. Pair again in settings.
Scan or enter a pairing code to use a remote AzurPilot. No local Runtime installation, startup, or Shizuku permission is required.
Select Pair on the AzurPilot remote access page to get a QR code and six-digit pairing code.
Point at your AzurPilot pairing QR code to scan automatically
Cannot open the camera. Go back to retry or use the six-digit pairing code.
Pairing failed. Check the network and code, then retry.
This code is invalid, already used, or expired. Generate a new code in AzurPilot and enter it again.
AzurPilot is offline. Wait for its remote access to be ready, then retry the current code.
Too many pairing attempts. Try again in one minute.
The pairing API was not found (HTTP 404). Update AzurPilot and AFA, then retry.
Remote AzurPilot is offline. Open it again later.
